G1_rules.esrs_sub_subtopic: Alignment of lobbying with material IROs and public statements
G1_rules.rule_statement: If company documents show lobbying positions or political engagement that interact with material IROs or may not align with public statements on those IROs, then negative impacts from political influence may be relevant.
G1_rules.identification_cues: lobbying position; main lobbying topics; public statements; material impacts; material risks; material opportunities; alignment; policy advocacy; regulatory position; political engagement
G1_rules.affected_stakeholders: stakeholders affected by the undertaking's material impacts, risks and opportunities, public authorities, investors, communities and other external stakeholders

impact_materiality.scale: Assess scale by the significance of the lobbying topic for material impacts, risks, or opportunities and the strength of any misalignment.
impact_materiality.scope: Assess scope by the countries, policy areas, affected stakeholder groups, and business activities influenced by the lobbying position.
impact_materiality.irremediability: Assess irremediability by whether the lobbying effect or public-statement misalignment can be corrected, clarified, or reversed.
impact_materiality.likelihood: Assess likelihood by evidence of recurring lobbying, high-value political contributions, register entries, or inconsistencies between public statements and lobbying activities.

G1_rules.source_excerpt: alignment between its public statements ... and its lobbying activities

G1_rules.rule_statement: If company documents show lobbying or engagement on proposed regulation that could significantly affect the business model, then an opportunity to influence regulatory outcomes related to material IROs may be relevant.
G1_rules.identification_cues: proposed regulation; regulator engagement; lobbying topic; regulatory regime; business model impact; policy advocacy; working with regulator; political engagement; material risk or opportunity
G1_rules.affected_stakeholders: the undertaking, regulators, investors, stakeholders affected by the regulatory topic and related material IROs

financial_materiality.magnitude: Assess magnitude by the potential effect of the proposed regulation on the business model, costs, benefits, and related material IROs.
financial_materiality.likelihood: Assess likelihood by evidence of active regulator engagement, clearly stated positions, lobbying activities, political contributions, or industry collaboration.

G1_rules.source_excerpt: proposed regulation ... could have significant negative impacts on its business model

G1_rules.esrs_sub_subtopic: Appointments from public administration or regulators
G1_rules.rule_statement: If company documents show appointment of governance body members who held comparable positions in public administration or regulators during the preceding two years, then political influence or conflict-of-interest risk may be relevant.
G1_rules.identification_cues: public administration; regulator; comparable position; revolving door; board appointment; management appointment; supervisory body appointment; former public official; former regulator; two years preceding appointment
G1_rules.affected_stakeholders: the undertaking, investors, public authorities, stakeholders affected by political influence and business conduct governance

financial_materiality.magnitude: Assess magnitude by the responsibility and scope of the prior public or regulatory position and its relevance to the undertaking's activities.
financial_materiality.likelihood: Assess likelihood by evidence of recent appointments, comparable responsibilities, regulator relationships, political engagement, or oversight gaps.

G1_rules.source_excerpt: held a comparable position in public administration (including regulators)

G1_rules.rule_statement: If company documents show late payments, long payment terms, or payment practices affecting SMEs, then negative impacts on SME suppliers may be relevant.
G1_rules.identification_cues: late payment; SME; small and medium enterprises; payment terms; average time to pay; invoice; contractual term; statutory term; supplier category; percentage aligned with terms
G1_rules.affected_stakeholders: SME suppliers, small and medium-sized undertakings, suppliers affected by payment practices

impact_materiality.scale: Assess scale by how payment delays or long terms affect SME suppliers and their economic stability.
impact_materiality.scope: Assess scope by the number or proportion of SME suppliers, invoices, supplier categories, countries, or payment value affected.
impact_materiality.irremediability: Assess irremediability by whether late payments can be corrected, compensated, or prevented through changed terms and payment practices.
impact_materiality.likelihood: Assess likelihood by average payment time, percentage of payments aligned with terms, payment-term variation, and recurring late payments.

G1_rules.esrs_reference: ESRS G1, G1-2, paragraph 14; G1-6, paragraphs 31-33; AR 16-17
G1_rules.source_excerpt: late payments to small and medium enterprises (SMEs)

G1_rules.rule_statement: If company documents show outstanding legal proceedings for late payments or material deviation from standard payment terms, then payment-practice risk may be relevant.
G1_rules.identification_cues: legal proceedings; late payment litigation; outstanding proceedings; standard payment terms; payment alignment; average time to pay; representative sampling; country payment terms; supplier category terms
G1_rules.affected_stakeholders: the undertaking, SME suppliers, suppliers involved in payment disputes, investors

financial_materiality.magnitude: Assess magnitude by the number of proceedings, payment delays, invoice value, affected supplier categories, countries, and potential legal or operational consequences.
financial_materiality.likelihood: Assess likelihood by recurring deviations from payment terms, current proceedings, long average payment times, and weak payment-practice controls.

G1_rules.source_excerpt: the number of legal proceedings currently outstanding for late payments
